## Checklist
- [ ] Acceptance criteria of the linked issue are met
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Line coverage of new code is at least 90%, or the description justifies why
- [ ] `./gradlew ktfmtCheck check` passes
- [ ] Large change (over ~15 files, shared architecture, or renames/moves)? Labeled `large-change`, 2 reviewers requested, heads-up posted. Unless the extra files only carry mechanical edits (e.g. one-line updates after a refactor). Then, one reviewer is enough, and the description starts with a heads-up that says so
- [ ] AI help acknowledged (comment at the top of each file, `Co-authored-by` in commits)
- [ ] Screenshots attached (UI changes)
